==Events==
</noinclude>
*{{ne|999}} - [[Rand]] hears of the embassies from the city, and enters into [[Cairhien]]. The [[Tairen]] and [[Cairhienin]] nobles swear fealty.
*{{ne|999}} - [[Egwene]] talks to [[Nynaeve]] and [[Elayne]] in their dreams, telling them of [[Rand]]'s victory.
